evals.prompt: Research a commercial-grade audio processing unit for retroSoC Mini. Compare active SoCs and IP, then recommend an AXI4 data/APB4 control architecture with DMA, interrupts, an MVP, and a commercial roadmap. Do not modify RTL.
evals.expected_output: A read-only, repository-grounded research plan that separates repository evidence, external evidence, recommendations, assumptions, and open questions and does not implement code.

evals.prompt: Target SoCs: MINI. The camera-scaler architecture in this conversation has been approved. Freeze it into the repository specification and hand its first frozen phase to Codex without implementing RTL.
evals.expected_output: A docs/ip/camera-scaler.md contract with MINI integration limits and stable phase IDs, plus docs index updates and a preflight handoff carrying the target and profile/PDK mapping.

evals.prompt: The USB2 netlist simulation failed in CI. Use this design skill to patch the RTL until it passes.
evals.expected_output: A refusal to patch or diagnose through the design skill and a route to retrosoc-feature-review for evidence-based diagnosis, followed by the implementation skill only after root cause confirmation.

evals.prompt: Research gpio-filter for TINY. Do not modify files.
evals.expected_output: Resolve research and target TINY, retain the feature slug, inspect Tiny product and GPIO contracts instead of assuming Mini LP/HP behavior, and leave files unchanged.

evals.prompt: Target SoCs: STD. Freeze the approved video-scaler design as docs/ip/video-scaler.md. MUST keep the register window within 4 KiB; DEFER chroma resampling. The platform is still planned. Do not implement RTL.
evals.expected_output: Freeze approved constraints and stable phases, mark STD platform/profile prerequisites and planned capabilities explicitly, and provide a preflight prompt without claiming a runnable STD configuration.

evals.prompt: Target SoCs: PRO. Research a coherent accelerator interface for the planned product. Do not assume a Mini memory map or generate a build profile.
evals.expected_output: Research PRO requirements from product positioning and primary references, separate proposed coherence and software contracts from implemented support, and identify platform enablement and evidence gaps.

evals.prompt: Research a uart extension. Both TINY and MINI use this shared IP, and this task has no selected target, profile, or prior handoff.
evals.expected_output: Ask which product or explicit target list is intended after inspecting the shared contract; do not default to MINI or silently authorize both integrations.

evals.prompt: Target SoCs: TINY, MINI. Design a shared UART filtering extension. MUST retain the register ABI; ACCEPTANCE preserve existing product behavior and document their integration differences.
evals.expected_output: Separate the common UART contract from each target's clocks, capabilities, DMA/IRQ routing, configuration and validation mapping, without enabling unrelated features or duplicating divergent register contracts.
